company_description: Engie SA engages in renewables and decentralized and low-carbon energy networks in France, Europe, North America, Asia, the Middle East, Oceania, South America, Africa, and internationally. The Renewables & Flex Power segment comprises renewable energy generation activities, including financing, construction, operation, and maintenance of renewable energy, such as hydroelectric, onshore wind, photovoltaic solar, biomass, offshore wind, geothermal, and battery storage. It also offers flexible thermal generation and electricity, pumping, and battery storage facilities; solutions for decarbonizing industry with low-carbon hydrogen; and operation of desalination plants. The Networks segment comprises the gas and power infrastructure activities, including the management and development of gas and electricity transportation networks and natural gas distribution networks in and outside of Europe, natural gas underground storage, and regasification infrastructure. description.long_fr: Engie est un acteur mondial de la transition énergétique. Le groupe couvre les énergies renouvelables (éolien, solaire, hydraulique), les infrastructures gaz (réseaux, GNL), les services aux clients (efficacité énergétique, mobilité) et la production électrique flexible. Présent dans ~30 pays. Chiffre d'affaires 2024 : ~73.8 Mds €.
description.long_en: Engie is a global energy transition player. The group covers renewables (wind, solar, hydro), gas infrastructure (networks, LNG), customer services (energy efficiency, mobility) and flexible power generation. Present in ~30 countries. 2024 revenue: ~€73.8 bn.
description.long_de: Engie ist ein weltweit tätiger Akteur der Energiewende. Der Konzern deckt erneuerbare Energien (Wind, Solar, Wasserkraft), Gasinfrastrukturen (Netze, LNG), Kundendienstleistungen (Energieeffizienz, Mobilität) und flexible Stromerzeugung ab. Präsenz in rund 30 Ländern. Konzernumsatz 2024: rund 73,8 Mrd. €.
